Each English word is looked up once in english_lookup: translation_senses are English Wiktionary translation boxes with their French and Spanish words side by side; glosses are the French and Spanish Wiktionary definitions of the English word. Only POS needed by a pivot are kept unless a pivot POS has no match, in which case all POS are kept. Each pivot carries pos_match per edition (true, false, or null when nothing was found). No equivalent is selected or approved.
